name: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 10L/28R, is 9,000 ft × 150 ft (about 2,743 m × 46 m); 10R/28L is 8,000 ft × 150 ft

hours.v: airport attended at all hours; tower and ground control 24 hours
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

customs.v: CBP clears general aviation 24 hours, 7 days (Eastern Time) at the FIS attached to the FBO; permission at least 1 hour before arrival, requested before leaving the foreign port
customs.quote: seven days per week, 24 hours per day

noise.v: all runways noise sensitive, noise abatement and a preferential runway use program in effect; no jet run-ups 23:00–07:00; voluntary: all aircraft asked not to use runway 10R/28L 22:30–06:00 local (2015 letter)
noise.quote: ALL RWYS NOISE SENSITIVE; NOISE ABATEMENT IN EFCT - 954-359-6181.

ppr.v: PPR only for aircraft carrying explosives; some taxiways closed to wingspans over 118 ft or 171 ft without prior permission

notes: US AIP Part 3 AD 2 Florida, HTML, read 28 Oct 2026; the page does not show its amendment (29th edition effective 22 Jan 2026; Amendment 1 dated 9 Jul 2026 is published); the AIP AD 2 index page could not be opened (https://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/atpubs/aip_html/part3_ad_2.0_.html). The AIP contact address is Broward County's (320 Terminal Drive) but no sentence states the operator. The 22:30–06:00 runway 10R/28L request is from a Broward County Aviation Department letter of 23 Apr 2015 (kfll-bcad-10r-memo), voluntary; it may be out of date. The AIP training remark ('ALL TRNG 2300-0700' with a 58,000 lb wording) is abbreviated and not clear, so not recorded. CBP fact sheet 15 Feb 2024. ft to m conversion mine (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
